scope: Actual early64-rank training validation only, fixed to the supplied immutable68-update snapshot. No new experiment run by recording agent.

configuration.precision: bfloat16 with existing selected FP32 components

raw_log_verification.raw_log_still_growing: Later progress is intentionally not substituted into this fixed68-update record.
raw_log_verification.trainer_order_verified: Code executes backward, finite gradient clipping, AdamW.step and zero_grad before incrementing global_step and updating tqdm; therefore68/30000 reflects68 completed optimizer steps, not a zero-based index.

dataset: Existing real public LIBERO LeRobot dataset, not mock inputs.

weights.actually_loaded: Existing converted pi05_libero_openpi model derived from user-provided pi05_libero_finetuned checkpoint.
weights.upstream_official_lineage: unknown; no new verification of upstream release identity or HF provenance.
weights.schema_flag_explanation: The schema allows only true/false. False is retained from the existing case because these are user-provided LeRobot-finetuned converted weights; it does not encode an unsupported claim of direct original-HF loading.

historical_independent_conversion_check.method: Independent safetensors header shape/dtype/offset and full binary payload SHA256 comparison; no model execution
historical_independent_conversion_check.output_parity: not measured; byte identity does not compare framework execution

weights.provenance_limit: Reuses existing conversion check; no new7.5GB file rehash or source-framework/NVIDIA execution. Log confirms configured converted path loaded, not independent revalidation of every current file byte.

finite_observation: All retained main-rank interval loss and gradient-norm values are finite; this is early training health evidence, not an accuracy comparison.

timing.scope: Trainer log wall time for ten updates, including data/forward/backward/HCCL/AdamW; this is not a separate synchronized benchmark. Initial model load excluded; checkpoints not yet reached.

causal_limit: QZ assigned different physical servers. Early training on the new allocation does not establish the first-job HCCL cause, repair the original servers, or constitute a same-node A/B.
privacy: No hostnames, internal peer addresses, private absolute paths, credentials, raw logs, source code, checkpoints or dataset contents included.
